_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'PROCUREMENT AUDIT REPORT' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-06.07.

f01_Procurements_or_Contracts_Audited.label: Procurements or Contracts Audited
f01_Procurements_or_Contracts_Audited.guidance: The specific procurement contracts, tender packages, and vendors audited.

f02_Audit_Scope.label: Audit Scope
f02_Audit_Scope.guidance: The scope, contract boundaries, and sampling methodology of the procurement audit.

f03_Period_Covered.label: Period Covered
f03_Period_Covered.guidance: The date range and milestones examined during the procurement audit.

f04_Audit_Method.label: Audit Method
f04_Audit_Method.guidance: The methodology used (e.g., contract file review, vendor interviews, financial reconciliation).

f05_Vendor_Performance_Audit_What_Worked.section: Vendor Performance Audit - What Worked Well
f05_Vendor_Performance_Audit_What_Worked.label: Vendor Performance Audit - What Worked Well
f05_Vendor_Performance_Audit_What_Worked.guidance: Aspects of contract scope, quality, schedule, and cost delivered successfully with supporting evidence.

f06_Vendor_Performance_Audit_What_Can_Be.section: Vendor Performance Audit - What Can Be Improved
f06_Vendor_Performance_Audit_What_Can_Be.label: Vendor Performance Audit - What Can Be Improved
f06_Vendor_Performance_Audit_What_Can_Be.guidance: Deficiencies, delays, or cost variances identified across contract dimensions with recommendations.

f07_Procurement_Management_Process_Audit.label: Procurement Management Process Audit
f07_Procurement_Management_Process_Audit.guidance: Audit evaluation across Plan Procurements, Conduct Procurements, and Control Procurements.

f08_Good_Practices_to_Share.label: Good Practices to Share
f08_Good_Practices_to_Share.guidance: Contracting best practices, negotiation tactics, and lessons learned for reuse across the PMO.

f09_Areas_for_Improvement.label: Areas for Improvement
f09_Areas_for_Improvement.guidance: Recommendations for updating organizational procurement policies, templates, and procedures.

f10_Comments.label: Comments
f10_Comments.guidance: Additional auditor observations, commercial context, or closing remarks.
